sections.title: Habit and reproduction
sections.text: Papaya is a large, tree-like herb of tropical regions that can approach 10 m tall. Its sparsely branched trunk bears very large, palmately lobed leaves near the top, often 25–75 cm across. Flowers may be male, female or bisexual depending on the plant and cultivar; the fleshy berries vary greatly and can reach about 50 cm.

sections.title: Fruit and latex
sections.text: The ripe fruit flesh is eaten; numerous black seeds fill a central cavity. The latex contains papain and can cause reactions in some people sensitive to latex. The plate correctly shows ripe fruit, a cut fruit and seeds, but is not advice to use latex or unripe fruit.
